t10.notes: By the T+10 window ABEEK had already become a full Washington Accord member (2007), joined Sydney/Dublin Accords as a full member (2013), and was formally designated as an engineering-program evaluation/accreditation recognition body (2013). In 2014 it evaluated programs at 54 universities and in 2015 continued national accreditation forums and operations.
